rules: PREREG.md T5 kalshi. Unrounded per-contract fees are the primary net. A cent-ceiling 10-lot variant is also stored. Tracked strikes are within 3 percent of the index.

KXBTCD-26NOV1212.title: BTC price on Nov 12, 2026 at 12pm EST?
KXBTCD-26NOV1212.rules_primary_head: If the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) before 12 PM EST is above 64099.99 at 12 PM EST on Nov 12, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
